# 1Finity, a Fujitsu company, announces availability of full-stack enterprise AI-Native vRAN solution

## Fully integrated solution enables Mobile Network Operators to monetize AI services now

November 4, 2026

KAWASAKI, Japan — Nov 4, 2026 — 1Finity, a Fujitsu company and leading global network solutions provider, today announced availability of a full-stack AI-Native vRAN solution. Backed by an open ecosystem of industry-leading partners, the solution will enable mobile network operators (MNOs) to economically accelerate their entry into the rapidly expanding AI services market.

To date, operators have not been able to fully realize over-the-top revenue from AI-driven enterprise applications. With 1Finity’s full-stack solution, operators can now expand their role in enterprise engagements — delivering private wireless networks alongside AI-driven applications.

At the core of the 1Finity solution is shared NVIDIA GPU infrastructure that supports both AI and RAN workloads. This integrated AI-Native vRAN architecture enables operators to deploy AI capabilities more economically than building separate, siloed compute environments. By combining RAN and AI infrastructure, operators benefit from improved resource utilization, lower costs, and faster time to market.

The complete, ready-to-deploy enterprise AI-Native vRAN solution stack includes:

- Open vRAN software and O-RAN compliant radio units from 1Finity
- High-performance AI servers from Quanta Cloud Technology (QCT) and Supermicro supporting scalable NVIDIA AI Aerial platform for integrated AI and RAN workloads
- A no-code platform from Aible that empowers business users to build, deploy, and operate AI agents using enterprise data, leveraging guided workflows and 100+ customizable templates
- Bridge by Armada, providing multi-tenant orchestration, security, and billing for large-scale compute deployments.

Together, this ecosystem enables MNOs to offer a comprehensive portfolio of AI and RAN solutions, accelerating go-to-market timelines and delivering differentiated, high-value services directly to enterprise customers.

“By enabling operators to deliver complete AI solutions — from infrastructure to applications — 1Finity is redefining how telecom networks create and capture value in the AI era,” said Patrik Eriksson, Vice President and Head of Mobile System Business Unit at 1Finity.

“The telecommunications industry is undergoing a foundational shift as networks evolve into AI infrastructure,” said Soma Velayutham, vice president of AI & telecoms, NVIDIA. “By building its full-stack enterprise solution on the NVIDIA AI Aerial platform, 1Finity is empowering MNOs with high-performance, software-defined AI-native infrastructure that seamlessly processes AI and RAN workloads. This is essential for operators looking to maximize compute utilization, deliver advanced capabilities, and unlock new revenue streams in the AI era.”

For more information, read the solution brief.

## About 1Finity Inc.

1Finity, a Fujitsu company, is a global provider of communications networks for our connected world. We uniquely combine technological leadership and expertise in open optical and wireless networking, network automation, and applied AI/ML to design, build, operate, and maintain critical digital communications network infrastructure. Collaborating closely with ecosystem partners, we deliver transformative outcomes for service providers and network operators, and enable them to lower TCO, improve network performance, and increase energy efficiency. For more information, visit www.1Finity.com.

cross_cutting.content:
##### Qai Builds Strong Global AI Partnerships Through Major UK Data Centre Project

Doha, November 04 (QNA) – Qai, a global technology company headquartered in Qatar, will expand its presence in the United Kingdom through a major AI infrastructure project on the Drax Power Station estate in the north of England.
The project is a major initiative under Qai’s AI infrastructure joint venture with Brookfield, announced in 2025, and forms part of Qai’s international strategy to invest in critical infrastructure that supports the deployment and adoption of AI.
This project will be delivered in partnership with Radiant, Brookfield’s AI infrastructure platform, and Drax.
The project will utilise Drax Power Station’s 4GW of grid access and 2.6GW of dispatchable generation capacity. The first phase, which will draw power directly from the grid, is targeting commercial operations in early 2028.
Qai Chairman and Managing Director, Abdulla Al Misnad, welcomed the project, saying: “Our partnership with Brookfield, including the recently announced Drax-Radiant data centre project, demonstrates Qai’s commitment to developing critical AI infrastructure and reflects Qai’s position as a global business with strong commercial ties in key markets such as the United Kingdom.”
Drax Power Station is at the heart of UK energy security and has supported the country’s growth for over 50 years. Drax Group CEO, Will Gardiner, said, “We are proud to be partnering with leading AI infrastructure providers on this project, which can help secure the long-term future of the site and protect hundreds of jobs, maintain a critical source of this country’s energy security, support northern growth and enable us to continue delivering for our local communities.”
Brookfield Global Head of AI infrastructure, Sikander Rashid, said: “Teaming up with Drax and Qai for this project represents a major opportunity for our AI infrastructure strategy. Our capital and deep operating capabilities will help accelerate the construction of a critical piece of sovereign AI, delivered by Radiant, our UK-headquartered compute infrastructure platform. In addition to preserving hundreds of jobs, this project will also create many direct and indirect jobs around the broader Yorkshire area.” (QNA)

cross_cutting.description: Verizon AI Connect合同近40亿美元 ... Verizon AI Connect业务签署近40亿美元合同，其中AWS暗光纤协议价值超20亿美元；公司称AI基础设施正成为增长驱动 ... Verizon与谷歌和微软的协议只是其AI Connect服务合作的较大客户群中的两个。
cross_cutting.content:
# Verizon AI Connect合同近40亿美元

讯石光通讯网 发布时间:2026/11/4 9:43:28 编者:Nina

摘要：Verizon AI Connect业务签署近40亿美元合同，其中AWS暗光纤协议价值超20亿美元；公司称AI基础设施正成为增长驱动，2026年资本开支指引维持160亿至165亿美元。

ICC讯 Verizon正在推进其AI Connect业务，已签署近40亿美元合同，结束了六个月来超大规模云厂商对其以光纤为核心的平台兴趣持续增长的局面。Verizon CEO Dan Schulman在第三季度财报电话会上告诉投资者，公司看到了新机会正在出现。他说，Verizon将利用数据、网络基础设施、广泛的客户关系和可信品牌开发各种新价值主张，未来将看到一家非常不同的Verizon，各种新的相邻业务正在向公司开放。

AWS暗光纤协议超20亿美元

Verizon AI Connect的势头体现在其与亚马逊云服务（AWS）的最新协议中。AWS将建设新的长途高容量光纤通道，连接AWS数据中心地点，使AWS能够继续为大规模构建和部署先进AI应用的客户交付和扩展云服务。Schulman指出，AI基础设施正成为Verizon真正的增长驱动，与AWS和谷歌的最新协议是其战略的证明。他说，Verizon宣布与AWS签署了价值超过20亿美元的暗光纤协议，这建立在上一季度宣布的谷歌协议基础上；这两份合同明确显示，世界上最大的AI基础设施建设者正在选择Verizon作为战略连接合作伙伴。

Synergy Research表示，AI正在推动加速增长预测。受AI驱动，关键的云和数字服务收入将在未来五年强劲增长。Synergy Research在修订后的全球预测中指出，云计算服务、云软件服务和领先的消费导向数字服务收入将从2025年到2031年增长三倍以上，2031年总市场将超过5万亿美元。

活跃的超大规模客户管道

Verizon与谷歌和微软的协议只是其AI Connect服务合作的较大客户群中的两个。Verizon在暗光纤、亮光纤和边缘计算地点都看到强劲客户需求。Schulman没有具体说明其他客户，但表示公司有“活跃的管道”，包括其他超大规模云厂商、neo cloud提供商和大型企业客户，他们正在谈判让Verizon提供暗光纤或亮光纤连接。他还说，Verizon看到众多合作伙伴利用其网络枢纽进行AI推理边缘计算的势头，这已经转化为签署的协议。这一需求是光纤和边缘计算将推动未来增长的好迹象。Verizon预计，AI Connect服务客户胜利带来的收入增长将在明年产生显著影响。

Verizon近期AI Connect合同的吸引力在于，它们利用其现有光纤和房地产资产。Schulman表示，为履行这些协议所需的增量资本适中，且基于成功、与确定合同挂钩；Verizon已经锁定光纤交付。展望未来，Verizon表示2026年资本开支展望没有变化。截至第三季度末，Verizon资本支出为119亿美元。Schulman说，公司有望实现全年160亿至165亿美元的指引，其中包括与AI Connect相关的成功型资本。

扩大光纤覆盖

Verizon不断增长的光纤网络支撑AI Connect。9月，Verizon与康宁达成数十亿美元的供应协议，获得超过8000万英里的高密度光纤，以满足激增需求，反映光纤正同时服务多种网络需求。该协议持续到2032年，提供扩展全国消费者宽带接入所需的高容量光学解决方案，同时扩展高密度骨干网以支持生成式AI计算需求。作为协议的一部分，Verizon将利用康宁的Flow Cable，使Verizon能够在管道通道内部署显著更多的光纤。这种柔性带状光缆最大化Verizon现有基础设施投资的价值，同时大幅增加网络容量和带宽。

Schulman表示，上个月Verizon宣布与康宁达成多年、数十亿美元协议，到2032年获得超过8000万英里光纤，支持其光纤宽带扩张以及AI超大规模厂商所需的长途骨干。他说，这些机会加在一起显著扩大了Verizon的可寻址市场、收入和利润，公司将在下次财报电话会上讨论如何帮助推动2027年增长。

Verizon Business报告总运营收入为70.2亿美元，环比增长2.6%。第二季度，Verizon总运营收入为343亿美元，同比增长1.5%；移动和宽带服务收入增长2.9%，被设备收入同比下降9.0%所抵消。

cross_cutting.title: UAE Business: Nutanix, Supermicro team up to lower AI costs
cross_cutting.description: Nutanix, a hybrid cloud leader and AI platform company, and Super Micro Computer, announced plans for a jointly engineered AI infrastructure solution powered by Nutanix Agentic AI designed to help enterprises take on runaway AI costs with a system for private inference. ... Supermicro servers, NVIDIA GPUs, and NVIDIA Spectrum-X networking. ... enabling them to simply deploy private inference and control
cross_cutting.content:
Nutanix, a hybrid cloud leader and AI platform company, and Super Micro Computer, announced plans for a jointly engineered AI infrastructure solution powered by Nutanix Agentic AI designed to help enterprises take on runaway AI costs with a system for private inference.

Built on the validated Supermicro systems powered by Nutanix Agentic AI, the solution will combine the Nutanix Cloud Platform with Supermicro servers, NVIDIA GPUs, and NVIDIA Spectrum-X networking.

Designed to reduce custom configuration and integration complexity, it will simplify the path from infrastructure deployment to production-ready AI. Nutanix delivers a complete, full-stack AI platform engineered to simplify and accelerate the deployment of enterprise AI workloads -- from underlying infrastructure to model execution and the governance of agentic workloads. The solution will help enable seamless provisioning from bare metal to delivering integrated model-as-a-service and a secure Agent Gateway using Nutanix Kubernetes Platform -- the Cloud Native Computing Foundation certified AI conformant Kubernetes distribution -- and Nutanix Enterprise AI, Nutanix said.

The solution will be supported by Nutanix Unified Storage (NUS) which provides high-performance NVIDIA Enterprise-certified storage for AI workloads, including context caching and model serving.

Together, these capabilities are intended to provide the end-to-end performance, resilience, and orchestration required to support modern AI initiatives. The built-in AI catalog will further simplify deployment by providing access to common AI applications.

As AI requirements grow, the architecture is designed to scale GPU capacity while the dedicated Nutanix control plane and storage services will support resilient operations and high-throughput data workflows. With this engineered offering, customers will be able to more easily deploy, manage, and scale AI inference workloads without having to assemble and connect a complex mix of multivendor technologies.

“Collaborating with Nutanix, we want to accelerate time-to-online for enterprise AI,” said Matthew Thauberger, Chief Revenue Officer, Supermicro. “Combining Supermicro’s engineered servers with Nutanix’s full-stack software will deliver a pre-validated, rack-scale solution that bypasses traditional lead-time delays. It will help give organizations predictable access to high-density GPU compute while removing the operational complexity of scaling AI.”

“Moving AI from experimentation into production remains a challenge for many enterprises, with infrastructure complexity and hardware procurement often slowing progress. Our expanded collaboration with Supermicro is a direct response to this barrier,” said Thomas Cornely, Executive Vice President, Product Management, Nutanix.

“The Supermicro systems, engineered with our Nutanix Agentic AI full stack software, will help enterprises simplify how AI infrastructure is deployed, operated, and secured, and scaled, enabling them to simply deploy private inference and control the cost per token as AI adoption scales.” - TradeArabia News Service

# 【拔萃资本｜投资企业新闻】Radiant携手Drax及Brookfield，拟在英国开发超200亿英镑AI数据中心项目

# 【拔萃资本｜投资企业新闻】Radiant携手Drax及Brookfield，拟在英国开发超200亿英镑AI数据中心项目

2026-11-04 17:03

发布于：北京市

（来源：拔萃资本）

AI基础设施平台Radiant宣布与英国能源集团Drax及全球另类资产管理机构Brookfield建立战略合作伙伴关系，计划在英国北约克郡Drax发电站开发、建设及运营吉瓦级（GW-scale）AI数据中心。Brookfield预计，项目总投资规模可能超过200亿英镑，有望成为英国规模最大的AI数据中心项目之一。

2024年，拔萃创新科技基金参与投资Ori Industries，支持其在AI算力云服务领域的发展；2026年，Ori被Brookfield收购，并入新设立的AI计算平台Radiant，共同打造垂直整合型AI基础设施公司。

项目规划

根据规划，项目将分三个阶段推进：首期计划建设最高100MW的数据中心容量，目标于2028年第一季度投入运营；第二阶段计划于2028年至2031年期间逐步扩容至500MW；2031年后进一步扩建，目标实现吉瓦级规模。

项目选址于英国北约克郡的Drax发电站，该场址占地约1,000英亩，拥有4GW电网接入能力、2.6GW现有可调度发电容量及配套冷却系统，同时毗邻英国光纤通信网络。依托成熟的能源及配套基础设施，项目有望缩短开发周期，提高大规模AI算力部署的效率与确定性。

项目将由Radiant负责设计、建设及运营，Drax提供土地、电力及电网接入资源，Brookfield则通过其与卡塔尔Qai成立的AI基础设施合资平台提供资本支持。首期项目预计获得约25亿英镑的资金支持。

合作背景

此次合作整合了Radiant的AI基础设施开发运营能力、Brookfield的长期资本及Drax的能源资源，共同推进英国吉瓦级数据中心建设。

Radiant首席执行官Mahdi Yahya表示，该项目将为英国AI生态系统的规模化发展提供重要机遇，使英国研究机构、初创企业及大型企业能够在本土获得前沿AI算力资源。

Brookfield AI基础设施负责人Sikander Rashid表示，Brookfield将依托资本实力及运营经验，支持Radiant加快关键AI基础设施建设，并为约克郡创造更多就业机会。

Drax集团首席执行官Will Gardiner表示，此次合作有助于保障发电站的长期运营、保护现有就业岗位，并推动英格兰北部再工业化。

Qai董事长兼董事总经理Abdulla Al-Misnad表示，该项目是Brookfield与Qai合资平台的重要举措，也是Qai国际AI基础设施战略的一部分，将支持英国AI生态系统的长期发展。

项目亦与英国政府推动AI主权及再工业化的战略方向相契合。英国政府近期推出《数据中心契约》（Data Centre Covenant），旨在加快战略性数据中心的电力接入及规划审批。项目目前正准备启动社区咨询及规划审批程序，首期建设仍取决于相关审批及租户落实情况。

关于Radiant

Radiant是一家垂直整合的AI基础设施公司，将具备公用事业级供电能力的土地资源、长期资本及自有AI基础设施软件平台相结合。

在Brookfield的支持下，Radiant为超大规模云服务商、大型企业、电信运营商及国家级机构建设和运营AI算力中心（AI Factories），提供具备规模化扩展能力、公用事业级成本效益及运营韧性的算力基础设施，并使基础设施的规划周期与AI经济的长期发展需求相匹配。返回搜狐，查看更多
